question: If X = (sin²theta)/(1+costheta) - (sintheta)/(cottheta - {cosec)theta} , then the value of (X-1) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Substitute θ = 45° into the given expression.

X = (1/2) ÷ (1 + 1/√2) − (1/√2) ÷ (1 − √2)

X = 1 / (2 + √2) + 1 / (2 − √2) = [(2 − √2) + (2 + √2)] ÷ (4 − 2) = 4 ÷ 2 = 2

Required value = X − 1 = 2 − 1 = 1.

From the options, sec²(45°) − tan²(45°) = (√2)² − (1)² = 2 − 1 = 1.

**∴ The correct answer is sec²θ − tan²θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

X = sin²θ / (1 + cosθ) − sinθ / (cotθ − cosecθ)

**Formula Used:**

sin²θ = 1 − cos²θ = (1 − cosθ)(1 + cosθ)

cotθ = cosθ / sinθ | cosecθ = 1 / sinθ

**Calculations:**

⇒ Term 1 = sin²θ / (1 + cosθ) = (1 − cos²θ) / (1 + cosθ)

⇒ Term 1 = (1 − cosθ)(1 + cosθ) / (1 + cosθ) = 1 − cosθ

⇒ Term 2 = sinθ / (cotθ − cosecθ) = sinθ / [(cosθ − 1) / sinθ]

⇒ Term 2 = sin²θ / (cosθ − 1) = (1 − cos²θ) / (cosθ − 1)

⇒ Term 2 = −(cos²θ − 1) / (cosθ − 1)

⇒ Term 2 = −(cosθ − 1)(cosθ + 1) / (cosθ − 1) = −(1 + cosθ)

⇒ X = Term 1 − Term 2 = (1 − cosθ) − [−(1 + cosθ)]

⇒ X = 1 − cosθ + 1 + cosθ = 2

⇒ The required value is (X − 1) = 2 − 1 = 1

⇒ Checking the options, the standard identity sec²θ − tan²θ equals 1.

**∴ The correct answer is sec²θ − tan²θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identities

Fundamental trigonometric identities: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, sec²θ − tan²θ = 1, and cosec²θ − cot²θ = 1.

Value Substitution Method

When simplifying complex expressions, substituting standard angles (30°, 45°, 60°) quickly identifies the correct option. Always avoid angles that make any denominator zero.

Reciprocal Trigonometric Ratios

Key relationships to remember: cosecθ = 1 / sinθ, secθ = 1 / cosθ, and cotθ = 1 / tanθ = cosθ / sinθ.
